### FAIL-001 — Deliverable Section 5 still says "20+" for workflow patterns — **Status: RESOLVED**

**Check**: Workflow patterns = 43 (20 original + 23 new). Must be corrected everywhere.

**Fix applied 2026-04-19**: line 194 of `react-flow-workflow-editors.md` now reads "A comprehensive taxonomy of **43 workflow control-flow patterns** (20 original + 23 new) with formal Coloured Petri-Net descriptions provides the vocabulary for what a workflow editor must represent [40]. Corrected 2026-04-19 — prior research said '20+' which significantly understated the count."

| File | Value found | Expected |
|------|-------------|----------|
| `react-flow-workflow-editors.md` §1 (line 33) | "43 control-flow patterns (20 original + 23 new)" | 43 ✓ |
| `react-flow-workflow-editors.md` §5 (line 194) | "A comprehensive taxonomy of **20+** workflow control-flow patterns" | 43 ✗ |
| `citations.md` [40] | "43 total patterns (20 original + 23 newly identified)" | 43 ✓ |
| `graph-tree-transformation.md` | "43 workflow control-flow patterns … (corrected 2026-04-19; prior research said '20+')" | 43 ✓ |

**Verdict**: FAIL. The deliverable has the corrected value in §1 but the uncorrected "20+"
survives in §5 ("Academic Foundations" sub-section under "The Representation Mismatch").
This is an internal contradiction within the same document.

**Fix**: In `react-flow-workflow-editors.md` §5, replace:

> "A comprehensive taxonomy of 20+ workflow control-flow patterns with formal Coloured
> Petri-Net descriptions provides the vocabulary for what a workflow editor must represent [40]."

with:

> newly identified) with formal Coloured Petri-Net descriptions provides the vocabulary
> for what a workflow editor must represent [40]."

### FAIL-002 — Deliverable Limitations table VERIFIED count does not match citations.md — **Status: RESOLVED**

**Fix applied 2026-04-19**: deliverable Limitations table updated to "48-49 (~89%)" with a note acknowledging the one-count variance between the citation-audit agent (48) and consistency-review agent (49). README changelog updated from "79.6%" to "approximately 89%".

**Check**: The Limitations section reports "43 (79.6%)" VERIFIED as the updated count.

Actual count from `citations.md` (all VERIFIED variants, including "VERIFIED",
"VERIFIED (2026-04-19)", "VERIFIED (2026-04-19, with correction)", etc.):

| Citation range | VERIFIED count |
|----------------|---------------:|
| [1]–[21] (original, no re-fetch note) | 21 |
| [22]–[49] (mix of plain and VERIFIED 2026-04-19) | 23 |
| [50]–[54] (new 2026-04-19 additions, all VERIFIED) | 5 |
| **Total VERIFIED** | **49** |

PARTIAL count: 5 ([34], [35], [36] note not PARTIAL — [36] is VERIFIED; actual PARTIAL: [5], [34], [35], [38], [39]) = 5 ✓

The deliverable table:

| Status | Claimed updated count |
|--------|-----------------------:|
| VERIFIED | 43 (79.6%) |
| PARTIAL | 5 (9.3%) |
| INACCURATE | 0 (0%) |
| INACCESSIBLE | 0 (0%) |

Mathematical check: 43/54 = 79.6% — the percentage is internally consistent with 43,
but 43 does not match the actual citation file count of 49 VERIFIED.

**Discrepancy**: 49 actual vs 43 stated = 6 undercounted. Most likely cause: the table
was drafted before all 2026-04-19 re-verifications and new citations were finalized, and
not updated to reflect the final tally. The five new citations [50]–[54] are all VERIFIED
and account for 5 of the 6. The remaining 1 is likely a miscounted entry among [22]–[49].

**Verdict**: FAIL. The stated percentage (79.6%) and count (43) in the Limitations table
are materially incorrect. Correct values are 49 VERIFIED (90.7%) and 5 PARTIAL (9.3%),
with totals summing to 54 (100% coverage — 0 INACCESSIBLE).

**Fix**: In `react-flow-workflow-editors.md` Limitations table, replace the updated-count
column values:

| Status | Updated count (2026-04-19) — corrected |
|--------|----------------------------------------:|
| VERIFIED | 49 (90.7%) |
| PARTIAL | 5 (9.3%) |
| INACCURATE | 0 (0%) |
| INACCESSIBLE | 0 (0%) |

Also update the prose below the table:
> "14 moved to VERIFIED, 5 remain PARTIAL" → The actual tally: 22 originally-INACCESSIBLE
> became 14 VERIFIED + 5 PARTIAL + 3 absorbed into other already-VERIFIED reclassifications
> (net +14 VERIFIED from that batch). Additionally 5 new citations [50]–[54] all VERIFIED,
> and several previously PARTIAL/INACCURATE entries were promoted to VERIFIED, bringing
> the final total to 49 VERIFIED.
